baseline.description: No change: keep the current setup
baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a insulating panel. The product of CBP ruling N360891, as its facts describe it. The insulating panel is assembled in Canada using components sourced from United States and China.

The Plaskolite Tuffac polycarbonate sheet are produced in United States. The double-sided adhesive nano tape are sourced from China. 

Final assembly in Canada: assemble the parts into the finished good.

Tariff classifications given with the product (HTSUS; the product's own codes, not verified by CBP): the insulating panel (the finished good), 8708.29.5160; the Plaskolite Tuffac polycarbonate sheet (made in United States), 3920.61.00; the double-sided adhesive nano tape (made in China), 3919.10.20.

prediction.decisive_step: Assembly of the polycarbonate sheet and adhesive tape into the insulating panel in Canada
prediction.reasoning: Under 19 CFR 102.20(p), subheading 8708.29 requires a change from any other subheading. Both the U.S. polycarbonate sheet (3920.61.00) and Chinese adhesive tape (3919.10.20) undergo the required tariff shift to 8708.29.5160 in Canada under 19 CFR 102.11(a)(3).
